verdict.rationale: Operating an identity-verification SaaS through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence shows no Identity feature that accepts natural-language commands. The only related item is Stripe's platform-wide MCP server, which gives AI agents tools for the Stripe API. That belongs to the separate MCP-server story, is not shown to cover Identity, and is a building block for an external agent rather than natural-language operation of the product itself, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
